title: The Pellet Is Defined By The Centrifuge

scenes.tts: How would you know that a vesicle carries a message? Start with how vesicles are collected. Slow spins remove cells and debris. A faster spin removes large vesicles. About one hundred thousand times gravity, for an hour or more, brings down the small ones.
scenes.caption: How would you know that a vesicle carries a message? Start with how vesicles are collected. Slow spins remove cells and debris. A faster spin removes large vesicles. About 100,000 times gravity, for an hour or more, brings down the small ones.
scenes.visual: Three tubes in a row: slow spin drops cells and debris, faster spin drops large vesicles, the very fast spin drops the small particles into a pellet.
scenes.narration: How would you know that a vesicle carries a message? Start with how vesicles are collected. Slow spins remove cells and debris. A faster spin removes large vesicles. About 100,000 times gravity, for an hour or more, brings down the small ones.

scenes.tts: The pellet holds everything of the right size and density, whatever it is. That includes protein aggregates, lipoprotein particles, viruses, and vesicles from the calf serum in the medium. Soluble growth factors can stick to any of these. These contaminants have changed conclusions. In 2019, Robert Coffey's laboratory separated such pellets further. Argonaute proteins, which carry micro R N A, were not detected in the exosomes.

scenes.tts: So a claim needs controls. Purify further, most often by floating the pellet on a sucrose density gradient. Membrane vesicles rise to about one point one three to one point one nine grams per millilitre. Free protein stays below. Ask whether the activity moves with the vesicles. Test the supernatant left after the spin, and a pellet from medium that never saw cells.

scenes.tts: And count. Copies per vesicle is cargo copies measured, divided by particles counted. If that number is far below one, or if the effect needs many more vesicles than the donor cells release, the case for signalling is weak, however clean the pellet. Your turn. Spin the medium from cell type A, add the pellet to cell type B, and B changes. Which controls do you need?
